Clean and up to date with origin. Here's the final report:

## Round complete — PR #4140

**bar-chart & equation (resumed, found already fully grown by the prior builder):**
- Both had complete Go/React/Elixir triplets, tier classification, and compose dispatch already in place.
- Found one red: `equation`'s golden fixtures were stale (starter `text` shape instead of the grown `tex`/MathML shape) — `toPlainText.typekeyed.test.ts` and `PortableDoc.parity.test.tsx` failed. Fixed by regenerating goldens via `mix barkpark.portable_doc.gen_pd_parity` (which also produced the real MathML expected output). No code changes needed for either block.

**criteria-progress (built this round):** attrs-only met/total rollup (`rows: [{label, met, total}]`, `detail: "total"` aggregates), riding the bar-chart proportional-bar vocabulary. Go/React/Elixir grown, removed the dead starter emitter from `core.ts` after moving the real one into `dataviz.ts`. `:widget`, textless.

**video (built this round):** native `<video controls>` element with poster/loop/caption-track support; email degrades to a poster image + link; TUI uses the asciicast/image labeled-box precedent. Asset-less video composes to `""`. `:element`, textless.

**Pin moves:** react registry 61→63, parity/showcase 55→57, TEXTLESS_SKIP 31→33 (all four sequential, live-read each time).

**Gates:** Go build/vet/test, JS build/tsc/vitest (293 tests)/eslint/size-limit, Elixir full `portable_doc/` suite (1086 tests) + tiers_test, parity-completeness (57/57), create-barkpark-app tests, cloud drift test — all green. Size budgets bumped +1.25KB proportionately with justification in the commit; changeset added.

One commit, rebased onto origin/main (no conflicts), pushed, PR opened, not merged: **https://github.com/FRIKKern/barkpark/pull/4140**

All four bp tasks (`pbw-stier-bar-chart/equation/criteria-progress/video`) stamped 2/3 criteria met (render + count-pins), held at claim epoch 3 under `stier-r2-builder`; "PR merged" left open per instructions.
